title: Reservation Terms for an Independent Living Apartment
content:
These terms govern the reservation of an apartment under the Independent Living Residency Agreement, before the resident moves in.

## Terms

1. An apartment is reserved for one named customer at one community.
2. The first resident must have reached at least the minimum resident age of the apartment type, in years, on the planned move-in date, judged by the date of birth on the customer profile.
3. The number of occupants contracted may not exceed the maximum occupants of the apartment type, so a Studio is single occupancy only.
4. The planned move-in date may not be later than the hold period of the apartment type — a number of calendar days after the reservation date; a later move-in requires a new reservation once the hold lapses.
5. The deposit taken is the reservation deposit amount of the reserved apartment type, paid in one instrument and recorded as one deposit receipt; a card deposit carries no convenience fee.
6. The contracted monthly service fee recorded at reservation is the published base monthly service fee of the reserved apartment type, and the rate effective date is the planned move-in date.
7. Where the customer also holds an Entrance Fee Agreement for the same apartment in reserved status, the contracted monthly service fee is the published base monthly service fee adjusted by the monthly fee adjustment percentage of that agreement's plan (set in the Entrance Fee Agreement charter; a negative percentage reduces the fee and a positive one increases it), rounded to the nearest cent, half up; a customer without such an agreement pays the rental base fee.
8. The deposit receipt may be posted only while the residency is in reserved status.

The minimum resident age, the maximum occupants, the hold period and the reservation deposit amount of each apartment type are the figures published for that apartment type.

## Evidence for each condition

| Condition | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Age of the first resident on the planned move-in date | The date of birth on the customer profile (system record) |
| Occupants contracted within the apartment limit | The occupancy the customer states for the reserved apartment type |
| Deposit receipt only while reserved | The residency status on the system record at the time of posting |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- **Fee with an Entrance Fee Agreement.** Suppose a published base monthly service fee of 4,000.00 and an Entrance Fee Agreement plan whose monthly fee adjustment percentage is a reduction of 12.5 percent. The contracted fee is 4,000.00 less 12.5 percent of 4,000.00, that is 3,500.00. With a hypothetical base fee of 3,968.00 and a reduction of 3 percent, 3 percent of 3,968.00 is 119.04, giving 3,848.96.
- **Age on the planned move-in date.** A first resident whose 62nd birthday falls on the planned move-in date meets a minimum age of 62 on that date; one whose 62nd birthday falls the day after does not.
- **Hold period.** For an apartment type with a 30-day hold, a planned move-in on the 30th calendar day after the reservation date is within the hold; the 31st day is not.
